name: [🐸TOAD SAGE 🐸 & ⚡YELLOW FLASH⚡] Anime Impact
desc:
📱💻🎮 You can play on any device. (CONSOLE, PC, MOBILE) 
⚡Collect new unique characters in your adventure! 
⚔️Lead your units into battle with a unique system! 
⛩️Upgrade your units for amazing skills! 

🔷Join the ROBLOX Group for +10% EXP in-game!🔷 
💎Premium & VIP users receive 2x rewards in AFK Realm.💎 

Join our community server at the social links below for codes and information.

Controls
-- Keyboard
Sprint = Left Shift
Confirm Selection = Spacebar
Quick Cycle = Middle Mouse Button
Target Cycle Left = A
Target Cycle Right = D
Cancel Action = Right Click
Flashstep = Q
Pass = C
Auto = X
Block = V

-- Console
Sprint = Left Joystick (DOWN)
Confirm Selection = A/X
Quick Cycle = Right Joystick (DOWN)
Target Cycle Left = LB/L1
Target Cycle Right = RB/R1
Cancel Action = Right Click
Flashstep/Cancel Action = Left Joystick (DOWN)
Pass = Dpad Up
Auto = Dpad Down
Block = B/Circle
Cursor = Select
